name: Party Pandas
description: Party Pandas is a 4,444-piece collection of looping party-panda PFP GIFs on Base. Each panda is stacked from six layers — venue, glow, panda, mood, fit, and extra — then flattened onto one 12-frame GIF. Classic black-and-white markings, crisp outlines, fluffy fur. Clubs pulse. Hats bounce. Confetti never lands.
